svg.title: HNAG1000-4-STX A4 Product Data Sheet
svg.desc: Native A4 product data sheet with editable typography. Original TRACI and Embuilded vector artwork is preserved without path changes.
svg.text: Continuous monitoring of EX, O2, CO and H2S
2.5-inch colour display, local audible and visual alarms, temperature and humidity sensing,
remote data transmission and multiple wireless communication options.
EX 0–100 %LEL; O2 0–30 %vol; CO 0–500 ppm; H2S 0–100 ppm
EX 0.1 %LEL; O2 0.1 %vol; CO 1 ppm; H2S 0.1 ppm
>16 h single gas; >12 h four gas without pump
Oil & gas • Chemical processing • Steel • Power • Wastewater • Tunnels • Hazardous-area safety
